name: General i SCSI
description: Windows MDM settings in the General i SCSI category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Do not allow additional session logins
properties.description: If enabled then only those sessions that are established via a persistent login will be established and no new persistent logins may be created. If disabled then additional persistent and non persistent logins may be established.

properties.name: Do not allow changes to initiator iqn name
properties.description: If enabled then do not allow the initiator iqn name to be changed. If disabled then the initiator iqn name may be changed.
